label: Updated 12 PM ET
title: Today In Golf
summary: A 30-second briefing on today’s biggest golf stories.

items.headline: Jackson Suber leads RBC Canadian Open
items.text: Jackson Suber is leading the RBC Canadian Open at 14-under par after starting Round 4 at TPC Toronto, with Jimmy Stanger and Bud Cauley one shot back at -13.

items.headline: Brooks Koepka withdraws with hand injury
items.text: Brooks Koepka withdrew from the RBC Canadian Open ahead of the final round due to a hand injury, putting his status for next week's U.S. Open at Shinnecock Hills in doubt.

items.headline: Justin Thomas backs PGA Tour cut pressure
items.text: Justin Thomas tweeted that making the cut can feel like more pressure than winning, supporting PGA Tour CEO Brian Rolapp's decision to keep halfway cuts in big-field Signature Events.
